originalTitle: Twilio (TWLO) Stock Trades Up, Here Is Why
summary: Shares of customer engagement platform Twilio (NYSE:TWLO) jumped 5.5% in the afternoon session after JPMorgan Chase raised its price target on the stock and continuing institutional demand from its addition to the S&P 500 provided momentum, while technology equities broadly rebounded from a sharp sell-off sparked by concerns over artificial intelligence revenue expansion.
content:
Shares of customer engagement platform Twilio (NYSE:TWLO) jumped 5.5% in the afternoon session after JPMorgan Chase raised its price target on the stock and continuing institutional demand from its addition to the S&P 500 provided momentum, while technology equities broadly rebounded from a sharp sell-off sparked by concerns over artificial intelligence revenue expansion.

As detailed by TipRanks, the company's addition to the S&P 500 index generated sustained institutional demand, as index-tracking funds are forced to purchase shares to match the benchmark. This index inclusion often creates extended buying volume from institutional investors. Additionally, the higher price target from JPMorgan Chase reflected increased expectations for Twilio's valuation, while optimism regarding its artificial intelligence communications strategy supported the upward move. Providing macroeconomic context, CNBC reported that major equity averages, including the S&P 500 and the tech-heavy Nasdaq, moved higher at the open on Friday as market sentiment stabilized across the SaaS sector.

According to Reuters, just a day earlier, shares across the artificial intelligence and broader technology space had faced heightened selling pressure following an OpenAI revenue report that rattled investor confidence regarding near-term monetization in the AI sector. However, market observers on CNBC noted the pullback proved short-lived as dip-buyers re-entered the market, viewing the valuation reset as an attractive entry point and highlighting an enduring investor appetite for leading technology firms.

Is now the time to buy Twilio? Access our full analysis report here, it's free .

Twilio's shares are very volatile and have had 24 moves greater than 5% over the last year. In that context, today's move indicates the market considers this news meaningful but not something that would fundamentally change its perception of the business.

The previous big move we wrote about was 14 days ago when the stock dropped 7.6% on the news that HSBC downgraded the stock from Hold to Reduce. The bank said that although Meta Platforms' Muse AI agent increases communications volume, it may not meaningfully expand Twilio's competitive moat or revenue capture per CNBC. A competitive moat is a lasting advantage that helps a company protect its market share and profits from rivals. HSBC also pointed to intensifying competition and stretched valuation levels. A stretched valuation means the share price looks high relative to the company's expected earnings or growth, leaving less room for the stock to rise. A Reduce rating signals that the analyst expects the stock to underperform and suggests investors lower their holdings.

Twilio is up 110% since the beginning of the year, and at $289.97 per share, it is trading close to its 52-week high of $301.27 from September 2026. Despite the year-to-date gain, investors who bought $1,000 worth of Twilio's shares 5 years ago would now be looking at only $904.13.

chineseTitle: Twilio (TWLO) 股票交易上涨，原因如下
chineseSummary: 摩根大通上调了客户互动平台 Twilio（纽约证券交易所股票代码：TWLO）的股价目标，加上该公司被纳入标准普尔 500 指数带来的持续机构需求提供了动力，该公司的股价在下午交易中上涨了 5.5%，而科技股则从人工智能收入扩张担忧引发的大幅抛售中普遍反弹。
chineseContent:
摩根大通上调了客户互动平台 Twilio（纽约证券交易所股票代码：TWLO）的股价目标，加上该公司被纳入标准普尔 500 指数带来的持续机构需求提供了动力，该公司的股价在下午交易中上涨了 5.5%，而科技股则从人工智能收入扩张担忧引发的大幅抛售中普遍反弹。

据 TipRanks 详细介绍，该公司被纳入标准普尔 500 指数产生了持续的机构需求，因为指数跟踪基金被迫购买股票以匹配基准。这种指数纳入通常会增加机构投资者的购买量。此外，摩根大通提高的目标价反映了对 Twilio 估值的预期增加，而对其人工智能通信策略的乐观情绪支持了其上涨。提供宏观经济背景时，CNBC 报道称，随着 SaaS 行业的市场情绪稳定，包括标准普尔 500 指数和以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数在内的主要股票平均价格周五开盘走高。

据路透社报道，就在一天前，OpenAI 的一份收入报告动摇了投资者对人工智能领域近期货币化的信心，导致人工智能和更广泛的技术领域的股票面临更大的抛售压力。然而，CNBC 的市场观察人士指出，事实证明，回调是短暂的，因为逢低买入的买家重新进入市场，他们将估值重置视为一个有吸引力的切入点，并突显了投资者对领先科技公司的持久兴趣。

现在是购买 Twilio 的时候吗？在这里访问我们的完整分析报告，它是免费的。

Twilio 的股价波动很大，去年有 24 次涨幅超过 5%。在这种背景下，今天的举动表明市场认为这一消息有意义，但不会从根本上改变其对该业务的看法。

我们之前写过的重大变动是在 14 天前，当时汇丰银行将该股评级从“持有”下调至“减持”的消息导致该股下跌 7.6%。该银行表示，尽管 Meta Platforms 的 Muse AI 代理增加了通信量，但据 CNBC 报道，它可能不会有意义地扩大 Twilio 的竞争护城河或收入获取。竞争护城河是一种持久的优势，可以帮助公司保护其市场份额和来自竞争对手的利润。汇丰银行还指出竞争加剧和估值水平过高。估值过高意味着股价相对于公司的预期盈利或增长而言看起来较高，从而使股票上涨的空间较小。降低评级表明分析师预计该股将表现不佳，并建议投资者减持。

Twilio 自今年年初以来上涨了 110%，每股价格为 289.97 美元，接近 2026 年 9 月以来的 52 周高点 301.27 美元。尽管今年迄今有所上涨，但 5 年前购买了价值 1,000 美元 Twilio 股票的投资者现在的股价仅为 904.13 美元。
